records.section_heading: First records of marine benthic algae from Swains Island, American Samoa
records.question: How many species of marine benthic algae are reported for the first time from Swains Island, American Samoa?
ground_truth_chunks: Fifty-nine species of marine benthic algae are reported for the first time from the coral reefs of isolated Swains Island, American Samoa, based on collections made during February 2002, 2004, 2006, and March 2008 under the auspices of the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
The collections include 4 species of blue-green algae (cyanobacteria), 38 species of red algae, 3 species of brown algae and 14 species of green algae.

records.question: On which alga do Peyssonnelia sp. specimens frequently appear as epiphytes?
records.ground_truth_answer: On the spongy green alga Rhipilia geppiorum W.R. Taylor.
ground_truth_chunks: Specimens examined: 2004: SWA-01-04, BISH 734572 on *Rhipilia geppiorum*; SWA-03-04, BISH 738775; SWA-07-04, BISH 738838; SWA-14-04, BISH 738886 on *Rhipilia geppiorum.* 2006: SWA-07-06, BISH 738949.
Note: Red prostrate, fan-shaped calcareous crust, up to 2.5 cm broad and 50 µm thick, appear frequently as epiphytes on the spongy green alga *Rhipilia geppiorum* W.R. Taylor.
